en.t: Never mind, do not trouble yourself...

units.source_text: 女人慌忙说道，那口气简直像在辩解，

en.t: the woman said hurriedly, in a tone that sounded almost like an excuse,

units.source_text: “多干些家庭手工活，在这里也能买到……

en.t: If I do more piecework at home, I can buy one even here...

units.source_text: 要是分期付款，交一些定金不就可以了吗？”

en.t: If it is on installments, would it not be enough to pay a small deposit?
